source: docs/research/demand.md: base case, all medical dictations of the private-practice physicians of canton Basel-Stadt routed to one reference house (deliberately generous customer base); heat-led wait policy as in unlimited.json. Scenario variant, not a case requirement.

arrivalsPerDay.source: docs/research/demand.md: 1,269 practising physicians in Basel-Stadt (415 primary-care physicians = 32.7 % of all, Jan 2024, https://grosserrat.bs.ch/dokumente/100406/000000406995.pdf, search snippet, accessed 2026-11-21) x 66.71 audio min per physician per month (median, Bax et al. 2011, Health Econ Rev 1:8, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3402968/, abstract, accessed 2026-11-21) x 12/365 months per day / 6.5 audio min per job = 428.2, rounded down

workUnitsPerJob.source: Bax et al. 2011, Health Econ Rev 1:8: median dictation length 6.5 min per letter, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3402968/ (abstract, accessed 2026-11-21)

workUnitsPerServerHour.source: Own measurement (T-02, branch feat/T-02-transcription-job: config/jobs/transcription-whisper-base.json, docs/jobs/transcription.md): 1000 Wh per 1 kW server-hour / 0.0382 Wh per audio minute (whisper.cpp base, whole-laptop gross) = 26,178 audio min, assuming equal energy per audio minute on the server

deadlineHours.source: Rev standard human transcription: estimated turnaround up to 24 h maximum, https://support.rev.com/hc/en-us/articles/18859196207629 (search snippet, accessed 2026-11-21); GoTranscript one-day tier, https://sonix.ai/resources/gotranscript-pricing/ (search snippet, accessed 2026-11-21)
